The [[Iguana]] is a [[charmable animal]] found in the [[Tarnished Coast]]. The tail is the Iguana's strongest muscle and is used both for defense and for propelling the reptile in water.

==Locations==
*[[Core]]
**[[The Battle Isles]]
***{{NPC location|Zaishen Menagerie Grounds}} (levels 5, 12, 15, and 20, depending on unlock progress)
*[[Eye of the North]]
**[[Tarnished Coast]]
***{{NPC location|Arbor Bay}}
***{{NPC location|Riven Earth}} (northeast of [[Rata Sum]], near the [[Golem Foundry]])
***{{NPC location|Magus Stones}}

==Notes==
*It uses a similar model to [[Dune Lizard]] but with a slightly different [[skin]].
*Evolved Iguanas deal [[slashing damage]], while Unevolved Iguanas deal [[piercing damage]].
*[[Zaishen_Menagerie_Grounds/Service_costs|Unlocking cost]]: 1{{zsilver}} plus 100{{gold}} or 1,000 [[Balthazar Faction]] ''(Common, Tyria)''
